name: Protokol Mitseliy
source:
You’ve been granted the chance to spend your life in an earthly paradise. In this world, fatigue and pain can simply be switched off, and you can lift your mood at any moment. Then, when boredom creeps in, you can slip peacefully into cryosleep. All of it is possible thanks to the Great Mycelium, the supercomputer that never forgets to care about each resident. But be careful. In Kudesh, it’s better not to notice how easily mistakes are "erased."

One day, a message arrives on Euphemia’s archive computer. It's from a friend who vanished long ago. His request will shatter the world she knows.

Will Euphemia help him? And at the end of the day, who will help her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426050/]Steam[/url]]
